messages.author: 6f17ff4d1bfe11d7
messages.subject: Dispersion parameter
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to find the dispersion parameter for the Poisson model using R-INLA.

When I use dispersion_check() in inlatools, it gives an error as below.

Error in object$.args$data[, response, drop = TRUE] : incorrect number of dimensions

data1 = list(Y = count[,1], mu = mu, Rpop = Rpop, year1 = year, S = S)

model <- inla(Y ~ 0 + mu + Rpop +
                f(S,model = "iid") + f(year1, model = "ar1"), 
               data = data1, family = "poisson", 
               control.family = list(link = "log"),
               control.compute = list(dic = TRUE,cpo = TRUE, po = TRUE))

dispersion_check(model)   

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Dispersion parameter
parts:
From a quick look at the user side code and error message, it looks like the inla tools code only supports data.frame data input, and doesn’t check for list() data input. Can likely be fixed by a simple is.data.frame check to use the appropriate indexing method.

Finn
